column1: # scripts/find_retrospective_cases.py --include use over the citation graph of every
# verified design DOI in registry/. 248 rows; by phrase family: miss 94, use 93,
# weakened 55, mismatch 5, redesign 4. 33 design DOIs are not in Europe PMC and
# same search WITHOUT the `use` family. That earlier queue was failure-weighted on
# purpose -- a documented failure is the scarce case -- and was declared spent on
# 2026-10-28 at 2 CONFIRMED / 1 VARIANT / 10 UNCONFIRMABLE. The `use` family is the
# opt-in half: a paper that simply RUNS a registry assay and reports a result is
# scoreable whatever the result. It returned 13 CONFIRMED (paper, assay) pairs in one
# EVERY ROW IS A READING ASSIGNMENT, NOT A CASE. A case asserts what a paper
# REPORTED: the as-of date must be the paper's own, the expectation must come from
# its results rather than its abstract, and the assay must be the one the registry
# holds rather than a modified version of it.
# `groups` says which phrase family matched; `phrases` is the exact text matched in
# the abstract. Run scripts/check_candidate_identity.py over a family before
# spending reading time: it answers whether the paper tested OUR oligos at all.
